site.title: The Chamber
site.heroTitle: The Chamber plots repo pressure as contacts on a live scope.
site.heroBody: Every open pull request, drifting issue, and red workflow run becomes a phosphor blip. Severity pulls it toward the origin. Click a contact and the teleprinter locks on.
site.description: A phosphor radar chamber for GitHub attention: live PPI scope, scored feed, and automated repo triage.
